title: G DATA Total Security TSNxGService Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-19776)
description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the TSNxGService component of G DATA Total Security. An attacker with the ability to execute low-privileged code can exploit this flaw by creating a symbolic link that causes the service to delete an arbitrary file. Successful exploitation allows escalation to SYSTEM privileges and arbitrary code execution.
